name: Egypt Labor Law No. 14 of 2025 Art. 124 annual leave tier floors on Egyptian hr.LeaveAllocation

payload.rationale: Conjunctive Egypt Labor Law No. 14 of 2025 (effective 2025-09-01, Art. 124) overlay on Egyptian annual leave allocations (jurisdiction_code == 'EG', leave_kind == 'annual', starts_on >= 2025-09-01): prorated_initial > 0d; first_year >= 15d (+7d hazardous/remote = 22d); standard >= 21d (+7d = 28d); senior >= 30d (+7d = 37d); protected_disability >= 45d (+7d = 52d).

response.expression: (((((self.entitlement_tier == 'prorated_initial') and (self.allocated_days > 0)) or ((self.entitlement_tier == 'first_year') and (self.hazardous_or_remote ? (self.allocated_days >= 22) : (self.allocated_days >= 15)))) or ((self.entitlement_tier == 'standard') and (self.hazardous_or_remote ? (self.allocated_days >= 28) : (self.allocated_days >= 21)))) or ((self.entitlement_tier == 'senior') and (self.hazardous_or_remote ? (self.allocated_days >= 37) : (self.allocated_days >= 30)))) or ((self.entitlement_tier == 'protected_disability') and (self.hazardous_or_remote ? (self.allocated_days >= 52) : (self.allocated_days >= 45)))

payload.subject: hr.LeaveAllocation
